conditional_approval_contract.rankings: Apply the 74h gate only to rankings.timeframes Candidate lists; build rankings.noTrade from all NO_TRADE rows.
conditional_approval_contract.long_horizon: Components are bool or null; any null makes the composite null; zero or nonfinite baselines are null.
conditional_approval_contract.candidate_counts: candidateRule74h counts eligible, notMatched and unknown within the non-NO_TRADE Candidate universe; an empty Candidate during warmup is valid.
conditional_approval_contract.oi_bucket: Floor Bitget source_ts_ms to five-minute buckets.
conditional_approval_contract.oi_upsert: Update an existing symbol/bucket only when incoming source_ts_ms is newer.
conditional_approval_contract.lookback_validation: change_lookback_minutes is fixed to 60, which satisfies the positive and five-minute bucket boundary; dynamic labels and retention are not implemented.
conditional_approval_contract.failure_semantics: DDL/init failure stops service startup; per-cycle OI failure publishes all OI as UNKNOWN with zero contribution and an explicit snapshot diagnostic.
conditional_approval_contract.ui_copy: OI UNKNOWN is 不明; 74h null is 判定不能; malformed Candidate metadata reports unavailable details and asks for a refreshed snapshot without claiming the cached ranking is gated.
conditional_approval_contract.vpi_boundary: Do not change or remove VPI-Lite+ OI availability; only confirmed equivalent non-VPI duplication may be removed.
conditional_approval_contract.qualification: Finite live smoke is separate from seeded deterministic exact-60m, retention and restart integration tests.
conditional_approval_contract.baseline: cwd apps/scanner-core; HEAD 8c3ecd4bf9ea16db0e99a0000f2f37fd89c3f583; focused command exit 0; 58 passed in 4.31s.
conditional_approval_contract.adr: Create ADR 0008 and do not rewrite ADR 0007.
conditional_approval_contract.basic_fixture: Balanced thresholds and non-NO_TRADE artifact values yield eligible=1, notMatched=0, unknown=3, ALTUSDT; adopt E2E 1/1 only after FixtureProvider computation proves it.
